861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23   9) /// Compose `filtered` with an optional recovery `hint`, cap the total at `raw`
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  10) /// (never emit more tokens than the command), print it, and return what was
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  11) /// emitted so the caller tracks exactly that.
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  12) pub fn emit_guarded(filtered: &str, hint: Option<&str>, raw: &str) -> String {
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  13)     let body = match hint {
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  14)         Some(h) => format!("{}\n{}", filtered, h),
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  15)         None => filtered.to_string(),
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  16)     };
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  17)     let shown = crate::core::guard::never_worse(raw, &body).to_string();
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  18)     println!("{}", shown);
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  19)     shown
861a46de (Adrien Eppling 2026-06-23  20) }
